chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād, from al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, who said:
He said to me: If you do not retain certainty about the first two rakʿahs, then repeat your salat (prayer).

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they are uncertain about the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer). It indicates that when one does not preserve certainty regarding the first two rakʿahs, the prayer must be repeated.
